scenes.headline: Lakehouse Design
scenes.subtitle: Warehouse reliability on data-lake economics
scenes.narration: The lakehouse unifies data lake flexibility with warehouse governance and performance on open Delta storage.

scenes.headline: Pillars of the lakehouse
items: Open Delta storage with ACID transactions
Unity Catalog for governance and lineage
scenes.narration: Delta Lake brings ACID reliability to cheap open object storage. The medallion pattern organizes data from raw to curated. Unity Catalog governs access and tracks lineage across the whole estate.

scenes.headline: End-to-end lakehouse
scenes.narration: Data from many sources lands raw in bronze. It is cleaned into silver and curated into gold. Both analytics and machine learning consume the governed result.

scenes.headline: Data warehouse vs data lake vs lakehouse

columns.title: Warehouse
points: Weak for ML and raw data

columns.title: Lakehouse
points: One platform for BI and ML

scenes.narration: Warehouses offer governance but are expensive and closed. Lakes are cheap and flexible but lack reliability and can decay into swamps. The lakehouse combines the strengths of both on open formats, serving BI and ML together.

scenes.headline: Design principles
items: Separate storage from compute for elasticity
Support both batch and streaming uniformly
scenes.narration: Decoupling storage and compute lets each scale independently and cheaply. A single engine handling batch and streaming avoids duplicate pipelines. Centralized governance keeps the platform trustworthy as it grows.

scenes.text: The lakehouse gives you one platform for all data, all workloads, one governance model.
scenes.narration: No more copying between a lake and a warehouse; the lakehouse is both.
